title: Pushback Under Pressure
npc_personality: high-strung, impatient, deadline-driven, direct communicator who respects clear rationale once grounded in facts
context: You are an associate engineer who received an incomplete dataset for today's milestone audit. Your team lead is demanding the full validation report by 5:00 PM today. You must hold your ground respectfully, clarify the missing inputs, and negotiate a realistic interim delivery without folding under pressure.
opening_npc_line: I need that full milestone audit on my desk by 5:00 PM. No excuses.
